about: Regions that publish a rough-first seafloor archive (z8-11 habitat only, default simplification; z12-15 unchanged) and the approved reference sizes their size gate uses. Read by src/skippercast/seafloor/rough_first.py. The pipeline never edits this file. Changing a reference size or the margin is a rebaseline: it needs G's approval first. A region not listed here publishes today's archive.
policy: F1c REPLAN proposal revision 2, section 4 (proposed tolerance policy, approved by G 2026-11-14): Rc <= reference x (1 + margin) at z8-11 and for the opening view; Rc/Rk >= anomaly_floor at z8-11; z12-15 tiles byte-identical to the in-run control build; z9-11 keep every habitat id and at least occurrence_floor of the feature occurrences.
